title: Object descent of affine degree-one Proj twists
statement: For a scheme S and a quasi-coherent graded affine-basis algebra A [def-nagata-relative-proj], there exist a module L on its relative Proj and isomorphisms chart_U from the tensor pullback of L to the actual degree-one twist [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf] on Proj(A(U)). For every affine U contained in V there is an additive transition on the sections of these twists over the inverse images of the respective base opens. It intertwines reading an L-section in the V chart and restricting with restriction and reading in the U chart. It sends the homogeneous section a/1 for every a in A(V)_1 to res(a)/1. Chart reading uses the section-normalized tensor unit [def-pc-module-pullback]. No base-module morphism is asserted.

proof.text: Use the scalar-extension twist comparisons along affine restrictions; their fraction formulas give identity and composition.

Refine intersections of affine base opens by affine opens. The comparisons agree on further refinements, giving overlap isomorphisms and the triple cocycle. Descend the actual twists across the relative Proj cover.

The induced restriction maps on sections are additive. Descent compatibility gives their equation with chart reading, and the homogeneous fraction formula gives the a/1 equation. Identify ordinary restriction and tensor pullback using the normalized adjunction.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_twist_chart_descent :
    ∃ (L : A.relProj.Modules)
      (chart : ∀ U : S.affineOpens,
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (A.relProjι U)).obj L ≅
          Proj.twist (A.grading U) 1),
    ∀ (U V : S.affineOpens) (h : U ≤ V),
      ∃ t : Γ(Proj.twist (A.grading V) 1, A.twistChartOpen V) →+
          Γ(Proj.twist (A.grading U) 1, A.twistChartOpen U),
        (∀ s : Γ(L, A.relProjHom ⁻¹ᵁ V.1),
          t (A.twistChartRead L chart V s) =
            A.twistChartRead L chart U
              (L.presheaf.map ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map A.relProjHom.base).map
                (homOfLE (X := S.Opens) h)).op s)) ∧
        (∀ a : A.grading V 1,
          t (A.twistChartFraction V a) =
            A.twistChartFraction U ⟨A.res h a, (A.res h).map_mem a.property⟩)
